facts.fact: Gabonactu reports that agents of the Treasury (DGCPT) took a three-day course on digital tools and artificial intelligence at the Centre Gabonais de l'Innovation, after officials of the Communication ministry and the Budget directorate (DGB) took it; no number trained is given.
